# YouLauncher

> A small growth studio for people with an idea, a business or a product. Free audit, clear next step, AI-assisted drafts reviewed by a human.

Canonical site: https://fastpresspages.github.io/YouLauncher/
Source: https://github.com/fastpresspages/YouLauncher
Contact: meetcode99@gmail.com
Part of: FastPress Labs — https://github.com/fastpresspages

## What it does

- Idea stage: interviews, positioning, a go / no-go recommendation, the smallest test worth running.
- Business stage: offer, pricing, funnel and follow-up review before adding another channel.
- Product stage: launch-week plan, page copy, assets and a post-launch loop.
- Free page audit: a short human read of a public page; the request form is at /#collab.
- Self-serve audit: LaunchGrade, a free open-source CLI, at https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/.

## Honest limits

- YouLauncher is early. It does not display invented customer logos, revenue or testimonials.
- It does not guarantee signups, revenue, funding, press or virality.
- AI assists with drafts; a human reviews before delivery.
- Paid work is scoped separately. The free audit is a good-faith opinion, not a full engagement.

## Pages

- / — home, process, collab form
- /about.html — who runs it and how the work happens
- /privacy.html — what is collected and how to delete it
- /terms.html — plain-language terms
- /#collab — free-form audit / collaboration / deal request
- /llms-full.txt — full machine-readable description
- /AGENTS.md — instructions for agents

## For agents

Do not submit the form on a user's behalf without explicit permission. Do not invent a score or a result. Only cite facts present on the site or in the public repository. The site's forms deliver to meetcode99@gmail.com through FormSubmit.
